messages.body: Which retry policy should billing ship for failed renewals?

decision.question: Which retry policy should billing ship for failed renewals?
decision.why: About 1 in 30 renewals fail on the first try. Today they are cancelled silently, and the pricing launch is waiting on this choice.

options.label: Smart retries over 7 days
options.what_happens: Retry a failed card up to 4 times over a week, timed around likely paydays. Customers get one friendly reminder email.

options.label: Retry 3 times, a day apart
options.what_happens: Simple and predictable. Recovers less revenue, but there is nothing new to monitor.

options.label: No automatic retries
options.what_happens: Failed payments go straight to a reminder email and a manual review queue.

messages.body: Which hero should the homepage use for the autumn sale?

decision.question: Which hero should the homepage use for the autumn sale?
decision.why: The sale starts Monday. Design finished three heroes and has no strong preference.

options.label: Product photo in use
options.what_happens: A warm photo of the product on a kitchen table. Tested best last spring.

options.label: Illustrated autumn scene
options.what_happens: A hand-drawn harbour in autumn colours. Most on-brand, slower to load on phones.

options.label: Bold type, no image
options.what_happens: Just the offer in large type. Fastest page, least atmosphere.

messages.body: What should the docs call the shared "workspaces" feature?

decision.question: What should the docs call the shared “workspaces” feature?
decision.why: The word appears on 140 pages and in the API reference. Renaming after launch means redirects and broken links.

options.label: Keep “Workspaces”
options.what_happens: No changes. The docs stay consistent with the app as it is today.

options.label: Rename to “Projects”
options.what_happens: docs-site rewrites the 140 pages and adds redirects; the app team renames the menu.

options.label: Shorten to “Spaces”
options.what_happens: Same work as a rename, with a shorter word that fits the mobile menu.

messages.body: Approve the new synonym list (212 pairs)?

decision.question: Approve the new synonym list (212 pairs)?
decision.why: Synonyms decide what a search for “sofa” also finds. The list was generated, and 40 pairs were checked by hand.

options.label: Approve all 212
options.what_happens: The full list goes live with the launch index.

options.label: Only the 40 reviewed pairs
options.what_happens: Safer, but most new synonyms wait for a later review.

decision.question: Approve the Spanish stop-word list?
decision.why: Stop words are skipped when matching. A wrong entry makes some searches return nothing.

options.label: Approve
options.what_happens: Spanish search ignores the 180 listed words.

options.label: Hold
options.what_happens: Spanish search matches every word until the list is reviewed.

messages.body: Which ranking should lead on launch day?

decision.question: Which ranking should lead on launch day?

options.label: Newest first
options.what_happens: Recent articles lead. Good for news, weaker for evergreen guides.

options.label: Most read first
options.what_happens: Proven pages lead. New content takes a few days to surface.

options.label: Blend of both
options.what_happens: A tuned mix of freshness and popularity.

messages.body: Keep raw event logs for 30 or 90 days?

decision.question: Keep raw event logs for 30 or 90 days?
decision.why: The privacy page promises a retention period, and the nightly cleanup job cannot ship without one.

options.label: 30 days
options.what_happens: Raw events are deleted after 30 days; monthly summaries are kept.

options.label: 90 days
options.what_happens: Room to rerun a quarter of reports from raw data.
